evaluation_population: at least two circuit families absent from training, calibration and architecture tuning
failure_disposition: FREEZE NOT_ESTABLISHED; DO NOT REOPEN TEST; DESIGN A NEW TRAIN/CALIBRATION-ONLY STUDY
holdout_rule: REMAINS BLOCKED EVEN IF V2.2 PASSES
one_shot_rule: ONE LOCKED TEST EVALUATION; NO RETRAINING, THRESHOLD CHANGE, OR RESELECTION AFTERWARD
rationale: TRAIN and CALIBRATION metrics measure dataset and retrieval properties, not independent generalization. Applying acceptance gates to them would constitute evaluating on development data.
scientific_claim: INDEPENDENT-CIRCUIT GENERALIZATION IS ESTABLISHED ONLY IF EVERY MANDATORY GATE PASSES ON BOTH LOCKED TEST CIRCUITS
uncertainty_method: hierarchical bootstrap by circuit then physical site; 1000 replicates; 95% intervals
